title: First cloud sync and production smoke test
description: Run apricity sync push from the analysis Mac to the production bucket, then a smoke test against https://apricity.anth.us: sign in, list clips, range-request a stem (206), play the hero with sound, and a second allowed user sees the same library. Add scripts/prod-smoke.sh (read-only checks: TLS, headers, unauthenticated GraphQL rejected, authenticated call works given a token) so it is repeatable. Record cost expectations and teardown steps in the design doc.
